project_focus: precision biomarkers of the exercise-induced immune "open window": per-marker validation-readiness map of conventional and omics candidates within the 0-72 h organising window
organising_construct: The exercise-induced immune "open window" is an organising construct only: it defines the post-exercise period after an identifiable bout (organising window 0-72 h after cessation, 72 h inclusive), the sampling time points and the marker families to be charted. The review does not test or adjudicate whether an open window exists; original authors' interpretations are charted descriptively (author_window_interpretation) and never affect eligibility or weighting.
validation_readiness_map_definition: Validation-readiness map: a per-marker, domain-by-domain descriptive profile across the seven precision domains; not a score, ranking, grade or development ladder.

methodology.appraisal: Prespecified design-appropriate critical appraisal, described domain by domain; no aggregate score and no GRADE.

research_questions.focus: Marker families, individual biomarkers, platforms, immune compartments and matrices measured within the organising window (0-72 h after cessation), in which adult populations and exercise settings (mode, duration and intensity as reported).

Time points covered within the window (0 to <30 min, 30 min to <3 h, 3 to <24 h, 24 to 72 h) and outside-window recovery points; handling of cell composition, hydration, sampling and other confounders; original authors' open-window interpretation, charted descriptively only.

Individualization: personal baselines, within-person variability, repeatability across bouts (Support B), response heterogeneity, subgroup (including older adults) or individualized models, and how they were validated.

Functions and clinical outcomes merely co-measured versus associated with markers; independent validation of monitoring or prediction uses; together with RQ1-RQ3 this yields the per-marker validation-readiness map and the remaining development requirements.

cohort_id.definition: Distinct participant cohort; primary evidence-counting unit.
cohort_id.counting_rule: Count the same people once even when represented by several reports, arms, assays, or timepoints. Link repeated cohorts across strata A and B; overall totals use the union, not a sum.

study_id.definition: Underlying trial, experiment, or cohort project; may link multiple reports and separately identifiable cohorts.

report_id.definition: One publication/version/report, including article, preprint, abstract, or protocol.
report_id.counting_rule: Report counts are separate from cohort counts. Link preprint/published versions and related publications; count only eligible peer-reviewed reports in the core.

record_id.definition: A measurements row (measurement_id) linked to sample_sets through sample_set_ids; never an independent cohort and not the screening record_id. Row units (PRE-004): conventional/targeted assays one named analyte × one author-reported test; omics one assay-universe summary row per analysis universe plus every candidate named in the main text, main tables or figure legends (prespecified candidates always), supplementary tables summarised by counts; set-level results one summary row per analysis.

linked_units.n_fields_note: Field names are extraction_template.json table.column names. Former labels: participant_n_distinct -> sample_sets.n_participants (cohort level: report_cohort_links.n_analyzed); arm_n -> sample_sets.n_participants on the row of each group_condition; biospecimen_n -> sample_sets.n_biological_samples; cell_or_preparation_n -> sample_sets.n_cells; technical_replicate_n -> sample_sets.n_technical_replicates; paired_within_person_status -> sample_sets.pairing_structure and participant_linkage; assay_n is a derived count of distinct measurements.assay_universe_id, never an independent n. Denominator rule (PRE-004): n_recruited = pre-exclusion enrolment; n_analyzed = unique participants analysed for the primary immune outcome of the report-cohort link, other denominators in link_notes; per-platform n only when reported (sample_sets split by platform); counts are integers or missing codes only.

eligibility_strata.A_core_acute: Identifiable single bout or competition of any intensity, duration or mode (recorded as reported; never an eligibility threshold), pre-bout baseline or suitable comparator, and at least one post-cessation sample; adults >= 18 y (separable adult stratum in mixed-age cohorts; older adults flagged as a subgroup). Immediate-only informs response, not recovery. During-only is excluded. No <30-minute minimum; 0-72 h is the organising window, not a maximum: later samples are charted and tagged outside-window recovery.
eligibility_strata.B_support_repeated_bouts: Retained as the cross-bout open-window monitoring layer: the same immune-related marker is measured in the same individuals after at least two identifiable bouts or competitions; each post-bout sample has a known or reliably recoverable exercise-to-sampling relation, and a baseline or appropriate comparator enables interpretation. Main evidence source for the individualization and repeatability domains. Separate from A; a cohort may meet both and is deduplicated against A by cohort_id, never double-counted overall.
background: Habitual activity or resting cross-sectional studies
General weekly or seasonal resting monitoring with unknown last-bout timing
Pure training pre/post snapshots with unknown exercise-to-sampling timing

Assigned only at full text through the administrative disposition RETAIN_BACKGROUND (original, generally healthy adult human studies with an eligible immune link whose only failure is exposure/timing); charted at reduced depth (bibliographic, design, population, platforms, n); no per-marker results or validation-readiness cells; outside every original-study denominator; not a census
Reviews (citation chasing), animal/in-vitro-only reports and post-hoc immune pathway enrichment without the prespecified immune link are excluded with their FT code, not background (v3.1)
eligibility_strata.excluded: Excluded at title (stage 1; closed-list code mapped to an FT code), title/abstract (stage 2) or full text with one primary FT01-FT08 code; not mapped.
eligibility_strata.uncertain: Awaiting classification or translation, or not retrieved; shown separately, never counted as excluded or as evidence.
eligibility_strata.frontier_preprints: Separate register and denominator; never included in peer-reviewed core totals. Link duplicate preprint-to-published versions.

ADVANCE_TO_ABSTRACT: none: title-stage disposition (v3.1, PRE-005), not a final scope
FRONTIER_PREPRINT: substantive stream as assessed (A_core_acute and/or B_support_repeated_bouts, or uncertain); publication_status = preprint keeps the report in the separate frontier register, never in core totals
ADVANCE: none: title/abstract-only disposition, not a final scope

precision_domains.meaning: Assay validation, precision, repeatability, standardization, quality controls, and measurement error.
Sampling coverage relative to the 0-72 h organising window (within-window bins and outside-window recovery), timing anchor, response and recovery behavior, and repeatability over time.
Immune-cell/mediator specificity and distinction between immune biology and generic exercise/metabolic or tissue-repair response.
Within-person baselines/variation, subgroup effects, individualized reference intervals or models, and response heterogeneity.
Direct immune effector function, tested association between marker and function, clinical illness/infection, or decision-relevant outcome; these are distinct evidence states.

Independent validation in distinct participants/cohorts and evidence that a stated monitoring, prediction, or decision use was actually tested. A proposed or inferred use alone is not tested use; distinguish internal resampling from external validation and label validation and use separately.
Sampling burden, turnaround, cost, platform access, interpretability, and deployment context where reported.

evidence_state_codes.source_note: evidence_state, direction, clinical_endpoint and validation are verbatim copies of data_dictionary.json controlled_vocabulary.evidence_state, result_direction, clinical_endpoint and validation_split. Map cells use evidence_state; the other lists are facet details mapped in crosswalk.

crosswalk.canonical: data_dictionary.json controlled_vocabulary.evidence_state (precision_validation.evidence_state); the validation-readiness map cells use these states.

rows.meaning: The report contains data that address this domain for this marker and support it.
The domain was examined with data and the result was null, not supported or did not replicate.
map_validation_codes: independent_site_or_cohort (validation did not support or replicate)

rows.meaning: The report addresses or proposes the domain but its data do not demonstrate it (co-measured without an association test; proposed use only; internal or same-participant validation only when independent validation is charted).
rows.appraisal_precision_profile_status: EVIDENCE_REPORTED (evidence_note states what was not demonstrated)

rows.meaning: Nothing on this domain is reported in the accessible report; not evidence of absence.
Domain not applicable to this marker/design.
Information is present but cannot be classified after full-text review.

rows.evidence_state: (none: report-level status, not a domain state)
rows.meaning: Report not retrieved or awaiting classification; no precision_validation rows exist.

functional_relation_to_relationship_tags.not_measured: no functional tag; functional_evidence = NR or NA

tested_use_to_dictionary_and_appraisal.proposed_only: validation_use_subtype = no_validation_or_use_test, with reports.author_stated_use or precision_validation.intended_use recorded | PROPOSED_ONLY
tested_use_to_dictionary_and_appraisal.tested_in_independent_cohort_or_prospect: validation_use_subtype = independent_cohort_replication | independent_external_model_validation | prospective_use_or_impact_validation | implementation_or_field_use_validation | TESTED

crosswalk.rule: Appraisal precision_profile_status is a coarser reporting-level code; three extraction states collapse onto EVIDENCE_REPORTED and the appraisal evidence_note must name which. Map validation codes are identical to controlled_vocabulary.validation_split. NR is the only not-reported code.

missingness_rules.NR: Not reported in accessible material; not evidence that it was absent or not performed.
missingness_rules.UNCLEAR: Cannot be determined from reviewed evidence.
missingness_rules.not_retrieved_awaiting_classification: Access/language/eligibility remains unresolved; do not mark scientifically ineligible.
missingness_rules.denominator: Every count or percentage names its unit and denominator. Use field-specific eligible/assessable denominators and show n/N. Do not infer sample sizes or aggregate analyte/timepoint rows as cohorts.
missingness_rules.figure_only: Results shown only in figures are not digitised: direction and significance are charted, values are NR and flagged FIGURE_ONLY; such rows are counted as reporting a direction, not a magnitude.
missingness_rules.background: Background reports are listed in a separate background register (bibliographic, design, population, platforms, n) and never enter original-study denominators, marker counts or validation-readiness cells.

time_display_only.origin: Retain exact source-reported timing and whether anchored to exercise onset, cessation, or another event.
time_display_only.rule: Single controlled list shared with data_dictionary.json controlled_vocabulary.time_bin and extraction_template.json (contract 8.3f). Bins up to and including 24h_to_72h_inclusive are within the organising window; gt72h is outside-window recovery and is shown separately, never dropped. Bins are for visualization only; never apply them as eligibility cutoffs or definitions of recovery. During-exercise observations are ancillary. Keep illness symptom timing on a separate axis. Boundary rules (data_dictionary.json time_bin_rules.boundary_rules; PRE-004): numeric value = earliest stated bound; an interval straddling a bin boundary goes to the later bin (flag TIME_BIN_STRADDLE); day-level timing converted to nominal hours (flag DAY_LEVEL_TIMING); "immediately after" without a number = 0_to_lt30min (flag IMMEDIATE_NONNUMERIC). Bin IDs, order and window positions are unchanged.

figures.title: Open-window time x immune compartment/marker family map
dimensions: exact post-exercise time from stated anchor
time bin (display only) and window position: within organising window vs outside-window recovery
marker family (controlled_vocabulary.marker_family, including mucosal_antimicrobial_protein from v3.1), conventional vs omics; named analytes classified by analyte, not platform
exercise context (mode, duration and intensity as reported) and population stratum (including older adults)
figures.unit_and_denominator: Unique cohorts are the primary unit within each displayed cell; reports are shown separately. A cohort represented in multiple bins is coverage in each bin, not a new cohort; do not add bin totals. Timepoints and assay records are not independent evidence.

figures.title: Per-marker validation-readiness map
dimensions: marker or marker family (rows), conventional vs omics candidates distinguishable
evidence_state per cell (evidence_present, measured_null, not_demonstrated, NR, NA, UNCLEAR)
figures.unit_and_denominator: Report unique-cohort and report denominators separately for each marker/domain cell. Marker rows can share cohorts and must not be added as independent evidence. Proposed use is not tested use; show NR/NA/UNCLEAR explicitly. Cells are descriptive states, never summed across domains into a score, ranking, grade or ladder. Source rows (PRE-004): precision_validation rows per report × cohort × marker_family (seven domains), plus analyte-level rows where analyte-specific evidence exists; background reports contribute no cells. Figure-only results (FIGURE_ONLY) contribute direction and significance only, never digitised values.

figures.title: Cohort-level validation links
figures.unit_and_denominator: Unique cohorts are primary; report, assay, outcome, and validation links are descriptive linked records. Multiple links from one cohort do not increase the cohort count.

standard_reporting_figure.status: Template only until formal searches and screening are complete.
standard_reporting_figure.rule: Never enter zero or any synthetic count; distinguish database and other-source records and report-level selection from cohort-level synthesis. Submitted with the PRISMA-ScR checklist as supplementary material (Frontiers in Immunology requirement verified 2026-10-04).

flow_stages.amendment: PRE-005 (v3.1): two-stage screening adds a title-screening box before the title/abstract box
boxes: Identification: records identified per database and other source; duplicates removed (DUPLICATE_RECORD / DUPLICATE_VERSION)
Stage 1 title screening: records screened; records excluded (EXCLUDE_TITLE), reported by closed-list code TI01-TI05 with its FT code
Abstract completion (process note, not an exclusion box): stage-1 retained records by abstract source; abstract_unavailable shown, not excluded
Stage 2 title/abstract screening: records screened; records excluded (EXCLUDE_TA) by FT code; frontier preprints routed to the separate register
Retrieval: reports sought; reports not retrieved
Full-text assessment: reports assessed; EXCLUDE_FT by primary FT code; RETAIN_BACKGROUND as its own line; awaiting classification/translation
Included: reports and unique cohorts (A, B, A and B), with the frontier register separate
flow_stages.count_rule: Counts are reported per stage only when that stage is complete (scripts/merge_screening.py prisma); otherwise blank and marked not yet performed, never zero.

includes: age range, adult-stratum separability and older-adult subgroup
exercise mode, duration and intensity as reported
time bin and window position (within organising window / outside-window recovery)

tables.unit: Cohort × marker family (or analyte, where analyte-specific evidence exists) × domain record
includes: whether a stated monitoring/decision use was tested
tables.rule: No aggregate score or candidate rank; cells feed the validation-readiness map (see the validation-readiness map definition in this file; contract 8.3e).

synthesis_rules: Count independent cohorts primarily and reports separately; assay records, analytes, platforms, cells, timepoints, and repeated samples are not independent evidence.

A and B are separate non-exclusive views; B requires the same immune-related marker in the same individuals after at least two identifiable bouts, with a recoverable sample-to-bout relation and an interpretable baseline/comparator; report overlap and use unique cohort union for any overall total.
Include null, inconsistent, and negative findings; no significance filter and no inference of baseline return from non-significance.
Functional co-measurement is not association. State an association only when the original report explicitly tests it.
Separate molecular annotation from direct function and self-reported symptoms from clinician-defined and pathogen-confirmed illness.
Do not call raw-change/noise-defined participants responders; assess measurement error and within-person variability before individual labeling.

No meta-analysis, clinical ranking, GRADE, or composite precision-readiness score; domain evidence is shown only as the validation-readiness map (see the validation-readiness map definition in this file; contract 8.3e).
Critical appraisal is descriptive, domain-specific, and not an unstated ranking or exclusion filter.
Keep the seven precision domains separate; proposed monitoring/decision utility is not evidence of tested use.
The open window is an organising construct only; the synthesis neither tests nor adjudicates whether an open window exists, and author open-window interpretations are charted descriptively.
Report samples within the 0-72 h organising window separately from outside-window recovery samples (> 72 h); both are charted.
Exercise mode, duration and intensity are evidence-map strata, never eligibility thresholds.
Only adults (>= 18 y) are charted; older adults are presented as a subgroup.
Background reports (RETAIN_BACKGROUND) are described separately and do not contribute marker results or validation-readiness cells.
Figure-only results contribute direction and significance only; no values are digitised (PRE-004).

submission_fit.portal_category_plan: Frontiers in Immunology "Systematic Review" article type, which includes scoping reviews (verified 2026-10-04); reconfirm the specialty-section dropdown at submission.
submission_fit.method_and_reporting: Keep JBI scoping review/PCC methodology with PRISMA-ScR and PRISMA-S; do not force PICO or meta-analysis.
submission_fit.acceptance: No acceptance or editorial-fit guarantee. Reconfirm current specialty dropdown, article type, and author instructions before submission.
reporting_supplements: PRISMA-ScR flow diagram (supplementary material; template until real counts exist)
submission_fit.ai_disclosure: Disclose AI use in both Methods and Acknowledgments with tool name, version, model and source, from 01_protocol/ai_use_log.json.
submission_fit.protocol_and_data_availability: Protocol v3.0 archived as GitHub Release v3.0 with Zenodo version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23147973 (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23147972); v3.1 (amendment PRE-004) is released as a new version under the same concept DOI; never registered in any registry. Data, templates and code: public GitHub repository + Zenodo DOI; documents CC BY 4.0, scripts MIT.

prohibited_inferences: The review adjudicates whether an open window exists, or the open-window hypothesis is proven, refuted or necessarily means post-exercise immunosuppression (the open window is an organising construct only).
A group mean or omics/AI finding alone demonstrates precision or individual utility.
A marker measured with a functional readout is associated with that readout without an explicit test.
NR means not assessed, absent, or no effect.
A non-significant test proves no change or recovery to baseline.
A time-display bin is a biological threshold or eligibility criterion.
A within-cohort random split is external validation or a raw change establishes responder status.

The synthesis establishes clinical readiness or return-to-training decisions, or a validation-readiness map cell is a score, rank or grade (see the validation-readiness map definition in this file; contract 8.3e).
Samples later than 72 h are outside the evidence base (they are charted as outside-window recovery).
An author's endorsement or rejection of the open-window hypothesis strengthens or weakens a marker's evidence.

not_results.note: Nulls above mean no formal results are available in this design artifact; they are not zero counts.
